layout.grid_strategy: Control Room Grid (Dense, Data Correlation) for Dashboard. F-Pattern Information Architecture. F-pattern means top-left quadrant has key metric.
layout.border_radius: max 8px (rounded-md or rounded-lg) for crisp edges.
layout.shadows: Minimal. Rely on 1px solid borders rather than soft shadows.

components.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border, no shadow. Hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow-sm.
components.buttons: Sharp, high contrast. Primary button is International Klein Blue (#002FA7). Action buttons use pure black or white.
components.tables: Shadcn Table. Left-aligned text. Generous row padding.
components.modals: Glassmorphism backdrop (bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl). Solid white modal surface with 1px border.
components.gantt_chart: Custom built using Tailwind Flexbox or CSS Grid. Progressive disclosure: don't overload, use tabs to switch between 'Original' and 'Modificado'. Use overlapping bars to show comparison.
components.forms: Shadcn Form, Input, Select. Stacked labels.

specific_views.dashboard: Bento Grid pattern. Top-left metric: Total Delays / Project Health. Progressive disclosure for Gantt (don't overload, use a tab or modal to expand).
specific_views.activities_crud: Table view with 'Nueva Actividad' modal. Modal contains Nombre, Duración (días), and multi-select for Predecesores.
specific_views.incidents_crud: Table view per activity or global. Modal to register Incident (Razón, Impedimento, Retraso en días).
specific_views.gantt_view: Horizontal timeline. Left column: Nombres de actividades. Right area: Time axis with horizontal colored bars. Support visual comparison.

image_urls.description: White concrete blocks in grayscale photography, used for empty states
Architectural details with a bright blue sky, used for auth layout side panel

motion.hover: Hover states on all interactive elements. Explicit text color on hover.
motion.transitions: Use transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out for buttons and list items.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text contrast against background. Focus states must have ring-2 ring-primary ring-offset-2.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='add-activity-btn').

instructions_to_main_agent: Language: Spanish for all UI text.
Install 'Cabinet Grotesk' and 'IBM Plex Sans' via Google Fonts or standard imports.

Build the Gantt chart using custom HTML/Tailwind grids. Do not rely on complex external Gantt libraries if they are hard to customize; a flex/grid based bar chart is sufficient and more aligned with the Swiss design.
For the original vs modified Gantt, overlay a red bar (modified) over or below the blue bar (original) to easily compare the delay.
Activity dates must auto-calculate based on predecessor chain: Start = max(predecessor_end) + 1. If no predecessor, Start = Day 1.
Incidents add delays to the specific activity, which cascades to all successors.
